rationale: The exact decision's provisional NO recommendation is supported within the supplied source perimeter. EO 13837 §§1–9, 83 FR 25335–25340 (PDF pp.1–6). Section 3 establishes union-time negotiation standards and reports; §4 imposes employee time/resource restrictions and authorization; §5 requires discipline/procedures/monitoring; §§6–7 impose recurring annual reporting and public disclosure; §8 requires implementation and CBA renegotiation. This is a broad ongoing regime, not a single 45/180-day task. EO 14003 §3(b), 86 FR 7231 (PDF p.1), expressly revokes EO 13837 as a whole. Sections 3(e)(i)–(iv) and 3(f), pp.1–2, specifically direct review and appropriate suspension/revision/rescission of authorizations, monitoring, guidance and implementation actions, without making revocation depend on completion. EO 13837 §§3(c),4(e),8(a),9(a)–(d) preserve statutory union time, leave, existing CBAs and statutory employee/agency rights; §9(f) is severability. None is a special post-revocation survival clause for the original order's restrictions or reporting. Independently binding CBAs and completed discipline are residual effects. EO 14148 §2(o) revokes EO 14003 but its full text does not affirmatively re-enact EO 13837. Its §3 review of implementing actions is not an automatic revival provision.
